Lorenzo Ricci  
📍 Mumbai, India | 📧 lricci@e-commerceinnovations.com | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/lororenzo-ricci  

**Professional Summary**  
Lorenzo Ricci, a seasoned game developer with 8 years of industry experience, specializes in delivering high-performance, scalable game solutions for enterprise e-commerce platforms. His expertise spans cross-platform development, real-time multiplayer systems, and advanced physics simulations. At E-Commerce Innovations Inc., he leads a team of 12 developers, driving innovation in interactive product demos and customer engagement tools. His work has contributed to a 35% increase in user retention for flagship platforms and a 22% reduction in server latency for real-time features.

- Designed and implemented a real-time multiplayer system for a B2B e-commerce platform, supporting 10,000+ concurrent users with <150ms latency, improving customer engagement metrics by 28%.  
- Led a team of 6 developers to integrate physics-based product simulations into a virtual shopping experience, achieving a 30% reduction in user-reported errors and a 15% increase in conversion rates.  
- Collaborated with UX/UI teams to optimize rendering pipelines for Vulkan, resulting in a 25% performance boost on mobile devices and a 12% improvement in load times for 3D assets.  
- Mentored junior developers in Unity and Unreal Engine best practices, contributing to a 20% reduction in bug reports and faster onboarding for new hires.

- Coordinated with QA teams to implement automated testing for multiplayer synchronization, reducing post-release bug fixes by 35% and improving deployment reliability.
